description: This file defines a template class RangeType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class models a range with minimum and maximum bounds, supporting operations such as comparison, validation, and range checking. It is a utility class likely used for range validation or boundary checks within the project.

classes.name: RangeType
classes.description: A template class representing a range with inclusive/exclusive bounds, providing methods for validation, comparison, and range operations.
